definition.zh: 以纯可可脂为脂肪体系的巧克力，强调口融、风味与调温后的光泽脆度，适合对口感和品质要求更高的应用。
definition.en: Chocolate built on cocoa butter as its fat system, emphasising melt, flavour and post-tempering gloss and snap — for applications with higher taste and quality requirements.

zh: 需要真实可可脂口融与风味
en: Need true cocoa-butter melt and flavour

definition.zh: 以代可可脂为主要脂肪体系的巧克力风味制品，加工便利、无需调温，适合规模化烘焙、包衣与装饰。
definition.en: Chocolate-flavoured products built mainly on cocoa-butter substitute fats: easy to process, no tempering required, suited to scaled bakery, enrobing and decoration.

zh: 优先加工便利与稳定性
规模化包衣、淋面与装饰

definition.zh: 以流动形态呈现的巧克力风味酱料，用于夹心、淋面、注芯、调饮与甜品，流动性与风味是主要选型变量。
definition.en: Chocolate-flavoured sauces in a flowing form for filling, glazing, injection, beverages and desserts, where flow and flavour are the main selection variables.

zh: 按夹心/淋面/注芯确定流动性
en: Match flow to filling / glazing / injection

definition.zh: 面向特定功能（如耐烤）或即用装饰（花小卷、插件）的巧克力形态，用于提升生产效率或成品呈现。
definition.en: Chocolate forms for specific functions (e.g. bake stability) or ready-to-use decoration (curls, inserts) that improve production efficiency or finished appearance.

zh: 希望减少门店现场制作
追求稳定一致的装饰形态
en: Need a specific function such as bake stability

definition.zh: 帮助采购与研发在纯脂、代脂、酱料与功能型之间做出选型判断。
definition.en: Guides that help procurement and R&D choose between couverture, compound, sauces and functional products.

definition.zh: 围绕具体工艺场景（烘焙、冷冻、饮品、工业）的应用方法与边界。
definition.en: Application methods and boundaries for specific processes: bakery, frozen, beverage and industry.

definition.zh: 解读巧克力相关国家标准、定义与质量体系。
definition.en: Interpreting chocolate-related national standards, definitions and quality systems.

definition.zh: 来自实验观察与应用验证的研发经验分享。
definition.en: R&D experience from lab observation and application validation.
